page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 32 GB of system memory. The instance includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that this instance sits on the lower end of the performance spectrum for modern workloads. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated in the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance and memory bandwidth tests consistently fall into the bottom 25%. The PassMark CPU score is average, but database operations, Redis SET performance, and static web serving throughput are relatively weak, reflecting the older Broadwell CPU architecture and Pascal-generation GPU.

Given its hardware profile, this instance offers a budget-friendly entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require high-end compute or memory bandwidth. The primary tradeoff is the older CPU and GPU architecture, which limits its suitability for modern heavy deep learning training. It is best suited for legacy GPU-accelerated applications, basic video transcoding, small-scale inference, and lightweight parallel processing tasks where cost efficiency is prioritized over raw performance.
